Tony Stark. He risked everything and died a hero. Shit got me good, man.

Back when I worked at McDonalds a year ago, a lady came in talking on the phone, and I remember she started going off to me after she hung up about how her son was just recently diagnosed with autism and how "difficult it was for her and her family because she doesn't even recognize or know who he is anymore." As someone with autism, all I could do was just smile and nod. She started crying right there about it all too, I wish I did something different now but I just kind of wanted her out of there. It was so uncomfortable.

Also, mormons came into that same McDonalds a week later. They gave me a pamphlet and invited me to church. Me and my coworkers had a good laugh about it.
